H2IL03162.name: Delia Ramirez
H2IL03162.bio: U.S. Representative; former Illinois State Representative and former Campaign Manager at Common Cause Illinois.

positions.stance: Supports enacting policies so that LGBTQ+ people can fully participate in society free from discrimination based on sexual orientation or gender identity.
Advocates stronger ethics laws, including banning legislators from becoming lobbyists, and comprehensive campaign finance reform including banning dark money.
Committed to fully funding the Department of Veterans Affairs and eliminating the backlog in processing VA benefits.
Believes war should only be undertaken when all diplomatic options have failed, and that Congress should reassert its constitutional power to declare war.
Champions building more housing, especially affordable and family housing, and protecting renters and homeowners from big banks and corporate landlords.

H6IL03163.name: Angel Oakley
H6IL03163.bio: Owner of a marketing and communications firm and former Winfield Village Trustee.

positions.stance: Would require accountability, oversight and periodic reporting for all House-allocated funds, and strengthen whistleblower protections.
Supports a digital civic engagement platform, a ban on foreign influence and dark money in elections, and a national voter ID standard with free verification.
Will fight to reduce inflationary spending and federal waste, cut red tape for small businesses, and lower taxes on working families.
Supports strong, accountable policing and strengthening border security "to stop cartels, trafficking, and illegal entry."
Will work to expand parental involvement and transparency in curriculum and limit federal overreach in local schools.
Committed to advocating for voter ID laws, "protecting women in sports and women's privacy in bathrooms," and continued border security.
Her mission includes "supporting the law enforcement community instead of the criminal element."
Will work to eliminate wasteful government spending so taxpayer dollars go directly to needy Americans instead of "politically corrupt NGOs."
"I will fight to overturn Democrat pro-criminal policies that have destroyed the fabric of our communities."
Supports school choice "so everyone (not only the wealthy) will have access to educational opportunities."

H6IL04153.name: Patty Garcia
H6IL04153.bio: Organizer and coalition builder with a Ph.D. in Education Policy.

positions.stance: Priorities include raising the federal minimum wage, passing the PRO Act, expanding the Child Tax Credit, and building more affordable homes.
Supports a pathway to citizenship, protections for Dreamers, and restructuring immigration enforcement agencies, "including abolishing ICE."
Says infrastructure projects must provide well-paid union jobs; supports prevailing wage protections, project labor agreements, and public transit investment.
Backs Medicare for All "to ensure healthcare as a human right" and letting Medicare bargain for lower prescription prices.
Supports increasing federal funding for public schools, expanding early childhood education, raising teacher pay, and student debt relief.

H0IL05096.name: Mike Quigley
H0IL05096.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 5th District since 2009 and former Cook County Commissioner.

positions.stance: Committed to eliminating waste, fraud and abuse in government; believes "it is impossible to effectively govern without the trust of the people."
Has been a leader in the fight for full LGBT equality under the law, including opposing the FDA blood donation deferral policy for gay men.
Advocates a diplomacy-first foreign policy and subjecting the entire federal budget, including the Defense Department, to targeted cuts.
Believes the only way to make government responsive is to open its proceedings to the public; co-chairs the House Transparency Caucus.
Supported the Affordable Care Act and opposes any effort to privatize Medicare.

H8IL05073.name: Tommy Hanson
H8IL05073.bio: Self-employed businessman and longtime commercial real estate professional.

positions.stance: Believes "the family is the most important element of society"; states "I am pro-life."
Would use the Tenth Amendment to bring the federal government back to its limited constitutional powers and address the spending crisis.
Supports "smart, sustainable and reasonable growth" and believes the economy will improve when crime is reduced.
Supports keeping violent criminals in jail as long as legally possible, "no early release and no reduced bail," and fully supporting law enforcement.
Believes "in robust, lawful immigration" and opposes illegal immigration and open borders.

H8IL06139.name: Sean Casten
H8IL06139.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 6th District, scientist, and former clean energy entrepreneur.

positions.stance: Supports universal early childhood education and access to quality public schools, trade school and higher education; opposes dismantling the Department of Education.
Lead author of the Cheap Energy Act; says energy policy must stop prioritizing energy companies and "put American consumers first."
Introduced a bill requiring gun owners to report lost or stolen guns within 48 hours and cosponsored the Bipartisan Background Checks Act.
Believes everyone has a right to universal, affordable health care; supports making ACA premium tax credits permanent.
Supports comprehensive immigration reform and pathways to citizenship; opposes deportations without regard for due process.

H2IL06090.name: Niki Conforti
H2IL06090.bio: Energy consultant and former healthcare administrator.

positions.stance: Will push for billing transparency, more marketplace options, and health policies portable across state lines.
"I am opposed to raising the Debt Ceiling"; will push to curb spending and limit national debt.
Says tariffs will help bring back manufacturing; will work to pass legislation to stimulate growth.
Supports getting "back to scholastics," gifted and special-needs programs, and protecting parental rights.
Supports requiring photo ID to vote and "3 forms of ID to register to vote."

H6IL07354.name: La Shawn Ford
H6IL07354.bio: Illinois State Representative since 2007; former Chicago Public Schools teacher and real estate business owner.

H2IL08203.name: Chad Koppie
H2IL08203.bio: Farmer, military veteran, and retired jumbo jet captain with 35 years of flying.

positions.stance: Describes himself as "a fighter for Life," including "the most defenseless in the womb."
Says "the education system is failing the communities of the 7th District."
Says "the government taxes too much, spends to much, wastes too much."
Opposes the emphasis the government puts on funding Planned Parenthood.

H6IL08329.name: Melissa Bean
H6IL08329.bio: Former three-term U.S. Representative with a career across the private, public and non-profit sectors.

positions.stance: Will address housing, healthcare, energy and education costs and invest in public education, workforce training and apprenticeships.
Supports comprehensive immigration reform with a pathway to citizenship; opposes mass deportation and supports mandated body cameras for ICE agents.
Will protect and strengthen the Affordable Care Act, extend premium tax credits, and reverse Republican Medicaid cuts.
Will champion worker training, incentivize employer pensions and profit sharing, and "protect the right to organize and collectively bargain."
Will expand access to affordable capital and reduce unnecessary red tape while maintaining strong consumer protections.

H6IL08311.name: Jennifer Davis
H6IL08311.bio: Entrepreneur and co-founder of the software company Davisware.

positions.stance: Will champion cutting excessive taxes, streamlining regulations, and new pathways for small business growth.
Supports a range of educational options—public, charter, private, or home schools—and cutting administrative costs.
Supports securing the border with advanced technology, streamlining legal pathways, and deporting criminal aliens.
Proposes a "Digital Dome" against foreign cyberattacks and online predators, and expanding American oil, gas and renewable production.
Will work with law enforcement to secure advanced training, modern equipment and technology, without higher taxes.

H6IL09228.name: Daniel Biss
H6IL09228.bio: Mayor of Evanston and former Illinois state representative and state senator.

positions.stance: Will work to restore federal antitrust enforcement, update antitrust law, and pass the End Hedge Fund Control of American Homes Act.
Will champion passing the PRO Act, protecting public sector unions' bargaining rights, and expanding sectoral bargaining.
Supports a Green New Deal, a "Polluter Pays Climate Superfund," and repealing fossil fuel subsidies.
Supports banning stock trading by members of Congress, small-donor matching for elections, and federal legislation banning partisan gerrymandering.
Supports a modest wealth tax on billionaires, rolling back Trump tax cuts for top earners and Trump tariffs, and closing the carried-interest loophole.
Supports "practical aid-based programs for addiction, homelessness, and mental health."
Committed to addressing local issues: "Listen before legislating."
Focused on policies that support working families while protecting religious liberty.
Supports transparency, accountable leadership, and bipartisan solutions that stabilize families.
Supports job creation through local businesses and removing burdensome regulations.

H2IL10068.name: Brad Schneider
H2IL10068.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 10th District; former business consultant and life insurance agency owner.

positions.stance: Says he is "fighting to combat rising costs for everyday necessities."
Fighting to protect the Affordable Care Act, Social Security and Medicare.
Fighting to protect "a woman's right to choose."
Fighting to protect "a healthy, sustainable environment."
Fighting to protect "full equality for the LGBTQ+ community."

H8IL14067.name: Bill Foster
H8IL14067.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 11th District, scientist, and co-founder of Electronic Theatre Controls.

positions.stance: Believes abortion "is best left as a private decision between a woman and her doctor"; committed to codifying Roe's protections nationally.
Believes "health care is a basic human right"; supports a public option and expanding Medicaid eligibility and coverage.
Helped write financial reforms such as Dodd-Frank to prevent future crises that disproportionately hurt working families.
Supports the DREAM Act and comprehensive immigration reform with border security funding and a strict but fair pathway to citizenship.
Will "do everything he can to block Trump's ongoing unconstitutional acts"; supports verified paper ballots and the John Lewis Voting Rights Act.

H6IL11166.name: Jeff Walter
H6IL11166.bio: Retired U.S. Navy Master Chief Petty Officer, technology consultant, and Mayor of Elburn, Illinois.

positions.stance: Supports Trump's America First economic plan, "including tariffs that protect American workers and jobs," and cutting red tape.
Supports making the Trump tax cuts permanent and rooting out fraud and waste in Washington.
Supports fully funding law enforcement, ending soft-on-crime policies, and holding criminals accountable.
Will work with President Trump to secure the border, finish the wall, and stop the flow of fentanyl.
"Jeff will never cut Social Security or Medicare."

H4IL12060.name: Mike Bost
H4IL12060.bio: Small business owner and U.S. Marine veteran from Murphysboro, Illinois.

positions.stance: Has fought to reduce regulatory burdens on farmers and ranchers and supports risk-management tools through the Farm Bill.
Supports an all-of-the-above energy policy, including using Southern Illinois coal resources.
Supported tax reform, rolling back regulations, and President Trump's trade deals.
Supports letting businesses and associations pool health plans and expanding Medicare Advantage.
Says Congress should be held to household budget standards and balance the federal budget.

H6IL12131.name: Julie Fortier
H6IL12131.bio: U.S. Air Force veteran and cancer research scientist.

positions.stance: Will fight to bring affordable healthcare options back to Southern Illinois; says the country "must move towards a universal care option."
Will work to ensure "that the VA is not privatized."
Opposes tariffs and "forever wars" that spike farm costs and is "a strong supporter of Right to Repair."
Says every worker deserves "the freedom to organize without fear."
Says climate change is real and action must include coal and energy workers; opposes data centers in Southern Illinois.

H2IL13153.name: Nikki Budzinski
H2IL13153.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 13th District; former labor organizer and Illinois state official.

positions.stance: Focused on passing the PRO Act to protect workers' rights and improving pathways to good-paying jobs.
Says families need a middle class tax cut; cosponsors the American Family Act for a permanent tax cut for working parents.
Focused on "bringing manufacturing back home, strengthening American supply chains, and investing in a 21st-century Heartland economy."
Advocates a strong, bipartisan farm bill that brings agriculture into the 21st century and supports family farmers.
Working to improve access to services for rural veterans and women veterans.

H6IL13154.name: Jeff Wilson
H6IL13154.bio: U.S. Navy veteran and nuclear engineer with leadership roles in the nuclear industry.

positions.stance: Believes founding values are "not negotiable": "I will never compromise on the Constitution."
Will focus on expanding Midwest energy to lower utility bills, strengthening local farms, and cracking down on onerous regulation.
Opposes "political indoctrination in schools" and forced DEI programs, and supports parental rights.
Will fight to keep the border secure, stop fentanyl trafficking, and stand with law enforcement.
Will defend family farms and expand nuclear energy, oil and natural gas to lower costs.

H8IL14174.name: Lauren Underwood
H8IL14174.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 14th District; registered nurse and former senior advisor at the U.S. Department of Health and Human Services.

positions.stance: Wrote the Health Care Affordability Act limiting Marketplace coverage costs to 8.5% of income or less.
Supports access to the full range of reproductive health services, "without restrictions," including safe, legal, and affordable abortions.
Believes gun violence prevention is a public health issue requiring "data-driven, evidence-based policies."
Believes the country must achieve "a 100% clean energy economy by 2050."
"She strongly supports comprehensive immigration reform, including a pathway to citizenship."

H8IL16153.name: James Marter
H8IL16153.bio: Former Kendall County Republican Chairman and information technology professional.

positions.stance: Will work to reduce the size and scope of the federal government and believes it "should live within a balanced budget."
Will work to dismantle policies that undermined energy independence, raised inflation, and put small businesses at risk.
Says big government threatens life, liberty and the pursuit of happiness; pledges to "restore liberty and protect your rights."
Calls for security within and at the border, citing trafficking, drug smuggling, gang violence and threats to election integrity.
Opposes schools pushing "political activism, gender narratives and junk science" on youth.

H0IL15129.name: Mary Miller
H0IL15129.bio: Third-generation cattle and grain farmer and U.S. Representative for Illinois' 15th District.

positions.stance: Fights for the "Right to Life" as a conservative, constitutional principle.
Fights for the Second Amendment as a conservative, constitutional principle.
Fights for ballot security as a conservative, constitutional principle.
Will fight to lower costs by taking on price gouging, lowering prescription drug prices, and making housing more affordable.
Will oppose discrimination and protect "the freedom of families to make their own healthcare decisions."
Will expand access to VA healthcare, especially in rural communities, and ensure the VA is fully staffed and funded.
Will fight to fully fund public schools, increase teacher pay, and invest in vocational and technical training.
Will lower prescription drug costs including insulin, protect rural hospitals, and defend Medicare and Medicaid.

H6IL18088.name: Darin LaHood
H6IL18088.bio: U.S. Representative from Illinois since 2015 and attorney.

positions.stance: Supports holding China, Iran and Russia accountable, securing the border, and increasing legal immigration.
Wrote child welfare reform and led the Fostering the Future Act to expand education, housing and job training for foster youth.
Secured Community Project Funding for roads, water systems and community centers, and supports protecting inland waterways.
Supports banning members of Congress from trading individual stocks and a bipartisan federal debt commission.
Supports year-round E15, a Farm Bill that protects crop insurance, and reducing tariffs on allies that hurt Illinois farmers.

H6IL16108.name: Paul Nolley
H6IL16108.bio: Executive director of Project First Rate.

positions.stance: Supports strengthening Social Security, Medicare and Medicaid and expanding Medicare to every American "with no premiums, copays, or deductibles."
Supports banning members of Congress and their families from trading stocks.
Will create policies to strengthen local farming and provide paths for young people to pursue agriculture careers.
Will fight for legislation that makes it easier to collectively bargain and raise wages and benefits.
Supports championing local manufacturers and expanding modern manufacturing as a viable career path.

H2IL17147.name: Eric Sorensen
H2IL17147.bio: U.S. Representative for Illinois' 17th District and former meteorologist.

positions.stance: Leading a bipartisan plan on year-round E-15, faster generic drugs, affordable housing, helping farmers, and clean water.
Working to ensure good-paying jobs in Central and Northwestern Illinois, including reopening the idled Belvidere auto plant.
"I support codifying Roe v. Wade and permanently restoring a woman's right to choose into law."
Supports law enforcement and has led efforts to deliver funding to local police departments.
Champions federal protections, mental health support, and dignity for LGBTQ+ families.

H6IL17247.name: Dillan Vancil
H6IL17247.bio: Coffee business owner, former railroad worker and SMART-TD State Legislative Director, and school board member.

positions.stance: Will be a voice for small businesses and "fight everyday to bring Manufacturing and real American Jobs back to Illinois."
Will push for funding to help Illinois students.
Will support Illinois labor.
Will "fight for price transparency in our broken healthcare system."
